summary: Join our comprehensive Emergency Preparedness and Response Planning Training Course. Equip yourself with essential skills to handle emergencies confidently.
lede: Emergency preparedness and response planning helps workplace safety and operations professionals assess risks and organize clear actions when incidents occur. You’ll learn to develop response plans, assign incident roles, coordinate communications, and test procedures through drills and reviews. The course also covers evacuation, resource management, and recovery priorities so teams can protect people and restore operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the safety and continuity of operations within their organizations. It targets those who need to plan, execute, and oversee emergency preparedness and response activities.
audience: Risk, compliance, and internal audit teams
Anyone assigned a role in emergency
modules: Emergency Readiness Mindset and Why It Matters
Evacuation, Shelter, and Life Safety Procedures
Medical Emergencies and First Response Coordination
Technology, Cyber Incidents, and Data Disruptions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of their organization’s operations and risk management processes. Prior experience in emergency planning or response roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
